in_marathi.name: Digu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Digu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Digu is derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'Fortune' or 'Prosperity'. This name is associated with the god of wealth, Lord Kubera. It is believed that individuals named Digu are blessed with good fortune and prosperity.
